JOB DESCRIPTION
Job Description
Overview
The Armed Security Officer is responsible for ensuring the safety and security of residents, visitors, and property within the apartment complex.
This position involves maintaining a visible presence, enforcing community rules, and responding to security incidents with professionalism and discretion.
Responsibilities
* Patrol the apartment grounds, parking lots, and common areas to deter unauthorized activity and ensure resident safety.
* Respond promptly to calls for service, disturbances, or suspicious activity.
* Enforce property policies and regulations while maintaining a respectful and professional demeanor with residents and guests.
* Conduct vehicle and foot patrols to prevent trespassing, vandalism, theft, and other unlawful acts.
* Prepare detailed hourly reports using our tracktik security system, on activities, incidents, and observations.
* Coordinate with law enforcement and emergency responders when necessary.
* Provide assistance to residents, management, and contractors as needed to maintain a safe environment.
Qualifications
* Must possess a valid armed security officer license or certification as required by state law.
* Proven experience in security, law enforcement, or military service preferred.
* Excellent communication and conflict-resolution skills.
* Ability to remain calm and act decisively during high-stress situations.
* Must be able to stand, walk, and patrol for extended periods and work in various weather conditions.
* Professional appearance and conduct required at all times.
* Join us in ensuring safety and security within our community by applying for the Armed Security Officer position today!
Job Types: Full-time, Part-time

jobs.description: Job Description As an Armored Driver Guard, you work with your team to ensure the safe and secure pickup and delivery of cash, coin, and valuables. Allied Universal, North America's leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, life insurance, a retirement plan, employee assistance programs, company discounts, and other perks, depending on the position and eligibility.

Job Description








As a Security Professional - Armed Retail Patrols PT in Austin, TX , you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Retail/Malls, and more.

Join a leading team where flexibility meets opportunity. As a Part-Time Security Officer, you'll use our exclusive Claim a Shift platform to view and Pick up open shifts based on your availability-giving you the freedom to build a schedule that works for you, while gaining valuable site experience across various industries. Whether you're looking to supplement your income or take the first step toward a full-time role, this position offers unmatched access to hands-on experience and growth opportunities. As a Patrol Armed Officer with Allied Universal, you will play a key role in helping to deter security-related incidents at a bustling retail location. Your responsibilities will include conducting routine patrols, maintaining a visible presence, and providing outstanding customer service to all visitors and staff. This armed post offers the opportunity to engage with the public while upholding our values of integrity, teamwork, and reliability. Join a team that puts people first and is committed to creating a secure and welcoming environment through innovation and care.

    Use our proprietary scheduling platform to claim open shifts at client sites

  • Support operations across a range of environments including commercial real estate, healthcare, and education
  • Receive site-specific training and guidance from experienced teams
  • Deliver consistent, professional security presence and customer service
  • Be ready to fill in at short notice when urgent needs arise

Responsibilities:

  • Provide customer service to clients and visitors by carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and responding to emergency situations as appropriate.
  • Respond to incidents and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, maintaining professionalism at all times.
  • Conduct regular and random armed patrols throughout the retail location and its perimeter to help to deter unauthorized activity and promote a secure environment.
  • Monitor entrances, exits, and other key areas within the retail environment to help to deter theft, vandalism, and/or other prohibited activities.
  • Document and report all security-related incidents, observations, and activities according to Allied Universal and site-specific protocols.
  • Collaborate with local law enforcement and/or emergency services as needed during incidents or emergencies.
  • Maintain a visible presence throughout the location to provide reassurance to clients, employees, and visitors.

What We're Looking For:

  • Availability across various days and shifts
  • Reliability and ability to adapt to different post assignments
  • A desire to gain broad experience and grow within the company
  • Interest in transitioning into full-time roles when available

  • Have at least three years of combined law enforcement, military, or security-related experience or possess a college degree.

  • Possess a handcuffing certification, which is preferred.
  • Hold a CPR certification, which is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
